One headline. Two hundred and one outlets. Where did it start?
OSAP sorts every report into five questions. What happened, why, what officials say, who is affected, and what comes next.
Officials' statements are tagged as claims. Never as fact.
The timeline shows the first report of each strand, in Zulu and local time.
Links finds other headlines naming the same places and groups, at home and abroad.
Then follow the trail into the connected story.
Reports lists every outlet that carried it, and where it's based.
Even who owns it, and who pays for it.
Every story is fingerprinted, so the record can be checked.
Use it when a claim is everywhere, and you need to know who started it.
